reference.criterion: Nonbiological intelligence and human-machine integration reach the extraordinary scale asserted for the 2045 singularity.
reference.rationale: The 2045 forecast is not yet due. AI capabilities are substantial, but there is no established measurement showing fulfillment of the entire singularity claim.
